d: Company Description Gulf Aviation Academy (GAA) is a professional aviation training provider based in Bahrain, serving the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. The academy offers structured training programs and courses for pilots, engineers, and cabin crew, supported by modern simulators and advanced training devices. GAA works closely with airlines to identify development needs and deliver hands-on, high-quality training with strong customer focus and 24/7 operational flexibility. Learners benefit from a holistic training experience that can include scheduling, accommodation, transport, and meals. Guided by a mission to provide end-to-end aviation training solutions, GAA aims to be the aviation training academy of choice and excellence in its markets.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Manama for an EASA A320 Synthetic Flight Instructor (SFI) / Synthetic Flight Examiner (SFE). The EASA A320 SFI/SFE will deliver ground and simulator-based instruction and checking on A320 aircraft systems, procedures, and handling, in line with EASA regulatory standards and GAA training syllabi. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing lesson plans, conducting briefings and debriefings, delivering simulator sessions, and assessing trainee performance and proficiency. The role involves maintaining up-to-date knowledge of A320 aircraft systems, SOPs, and regulatory requirements, contributing to course development and continuous improvement, and ensuring all training documentation and records are accurately completed. The SFI/SFE will work closely with training management, other instructors, and airline clients to support safe, effective, and customer-focused training delivery.
q: Current or recent EASA approval as A320 SFI and/or SFE, with strong knowledge of A320 aircraft systems, procedures, and performance.
Demonstrated experience in simulator and classroom instruction, including briefing, debriefing, and competency-based assessment of flight crew.
Thorough understanding of EASA regulations, airline SOPs, and safety management principles relevant to A320 training operations.
Strong communication, coaching, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback in a multicultural environment.
Proficiency in English suitable for aviation training and documentation; additional regional languages are an advantage.
High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail, with a commitment to safety, compliance, and customer-focused service.
Experience working with modern full-flight simulators and training devices, including basic troubleshooting and effective use of simulator features.
Ability to work flexibly, including variable hours and shifts, in line with 24/7 training operations.
Previous airline or A320 operational experience as flight crew
